newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thai currency crisis does not warrant support - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Thai currency crisis does not warrant support - BOJ.

text.p: Thailand's currency crisis is not serious enough to warrant support from Japan, a senior Bank of Japan (BOJ) official told reporters on Friday.

He was responding to a question on whether Japan would participate in a financial rescue package for Thailand, whose markets were sent into a frenzy last week after the announcement of a de facto devaluation of its currency.
Thai officials said earlier this week that Bangkok was studying the requirements and prospects of tapping multi-million dollar foreign loans to ease its credit crunch.
Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya arrives here next week and is scheduled to meet BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita.
